svg.title: 三仓训练工作流
svg.desc: train_fsdp2 与并行装配就绪后，每步从 batch 进入前向，再经 autograd、EP 归主、Expert-FSDP 梯度同步与参数更新。泳道按代码职责划分。

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 252px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 252px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 252px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
I03 进入 train_fsdp2
I04 创建模型

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
S06 取 batch
F03 模型调用专家

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
F16 合并 routed / shared
S10 合成 loss
U01 反向可重算前向

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: B17 梯度回上游计算图

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
U07 更新参数分片
U08 调度与清梯度

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
I07 绑定 EP dispatcher
I15 注册 FSDP hooks

div.style: color: rgb(21, 40, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
F17 准备前向参数
F06 专家派发入口

span.p: U02 恢复 home 参数
